| Vasovagal syncope | Prodromal warmth, nausea, standing posture | Transient bradycardia; no baseline ECG pathology |
Look‑alike conditions: serum sickness, acute urticaria, vasovagal syncope, septic shock.
Most common causes of reduced consciousness/awareness attacks: neurocardiogenic (vasovagal) syncope, epilepsy.
